title: ReelSaid — Instagram Reels Transcript API
description: Transcribe public Instagram Reels from links, profiles, shortcodes, media URLs, or an Apify dataset. Replace the prefilled spoken Reel with your own source, or keep it for a real test run. The prefill runs only when it is included in your input.

startUrls.title: Instagram URLs
startUrls.description: Enter one URL or a list. Accepts public Instagram Reels, video posts, carousels, profile URLs, and direct Instagram CDN video or audio URLs.

profiles.title: Instagram profiles
profiles.description: Find public Reels on personal, creator, or business profiles. Enter account handles or profile URLs.

shortcodes.title: Instagram shortcodes
shortcodes.description: Enter the post identifiers found after /reel/, /p/, or /tv/ in Instagram URLs.

datasetId.title: Source Apify dataset ID
datasetId.description: Read accessible Instagram video records from a previous Actor run.

datasetItems.title: Inline dataset records
datasetItems.description: Paste records from another workflow. Include the original Instagram post URL alongside videoUrl or audioUrl when available so the Actor can recover expired media links.

language.title: Spoken language
language.description: Use auto for automatic language detection, or enter a supported language code such as es, ar, fr, or ja. Transcripts preserve the original language.

preferCaptions.title: Prefer original captions
preferCaptions.description: Use original-language captions when they provide a usable, timed transcript. Turn off to use audio transcription.

wordLevelTimestamps.title: Word-level timestamps
wordLevelTimestamps.description: Include the start and end times of individual words when available.

includeSrt.title: SRT subtitles
includeSrt.description: Return an SRT file for each transcript with usable timing.

includeVtt.title: WebVTT subtitles
includeVtt.description: Return a WebVTT file for each transcript with usable timing.

dateFrom.title: Published on or after
dateFrom.description: Keep videos published on or after this UTC date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

dateTo.title: Published on or before
dateTo.description: Keep videos published on or before this UTC date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

lastDays.title: Published in the last days
lastDays.description: Keep videos published in the specified number of days before the run.

minViews.title: Minimum views
minViews.description: Keep videos with at least this many views.

minLikes.title: Minimum likes
minLikes.description: Keep videos with at least this many likes.

minDurationSeconds.title: Minimum duration in seconds
minDurationSeconds.description: Keep videos or audio tracks at least this long.

maxDurationSeconds.title: Maximum duration in seconds
maxDurationSeconds.description: Skip videos or audio tracks longer than this before transcription.

skipPinned.title: Skip pinned Reels
skipPinned.description: Skip Reels pinned to the profile used for discovery.

sort.title: Processing order
sort.description: Process the newest videos first or prioritize videos with the most views.

maxResults.title: Maximum videos per run
maxResults.description: Limit the number of distinct videos selected for processing in this run. Each video in a carousel is counted separately.

watchlistId.title: Watchlist ID
watchlistId.description: Name this watchlist in your Apify account. Reuse the same ID in a scheduled task to track which videos it has answered.

newReelsOnly.title: Only unanswered Reels
newReelsOnly.description: Start with currently eligible videos. Later runs of the same watchlist skip videos that already received a final result.

forceRefresh.title: Refresh transcripts
forceRefresh.description: Process the selected videos again instead of returning saved transcripts. A new eligible transcript can incur a new charge.

resumeFromDatasetId.title: Resume from a prior run dataset
resumeFromDatasetId.description: Continue unfinished work from a previous ReelSaid run in your account. Completed and paid results remain available in the original run.
